scope: Opt-in, read-only protected32 eligibility census over 60 million ordinary AT machine-step calls with external Windows 3.11 media. No media bytes or paths are included.

guestParity.result: Exact equality with the pinned ordinary guest report after deleting only source/revision and later diagnostic/option fields.
guestParity.normalization: Delete executionRevision, sourceSha256, native32Census, inputs.code16Wasm, code16WasmStats, inputs.code16Loads, code16LoadExecutions; sort keys with jq -S.

decision.threshold: At least 1,500,000 same-entry retired calls for a new executable opcode family before implementation is considered.
decision.result: No new narrow family clears the threshold. MOV 8B clears it but is already supported; most of its calls have a single-instruction candidate or decode null. Investigate block exits and grouped forms before adding native execution.
decision.upperBound: At most 15,277,507 protected32 entry calls on this workload can be affected by a protected32-only path; candidate starts overlap and do not sum to unique executable coverage.

limits: The census decodes at every ordinary entry and does not mirror the native dispatcher cache. Its 10,055,120 decode-null attempts are not the 12,536,754 native null-cache hits reported by an earlier separate run. Candidate length does not prove executable coverage; unsupported-or-page-boundary is a coarse exit category. No speedup is claimed.
validation: Measured revision: full i80386 suite 438 passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed. Final rebased candidate: full i80386 suite 439 passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed; private receipt pins external media and raw report hashes.

rebasedCandidate.note: The 60M measurement used pre-rebase CLI SHA 1f314715ae698fcc92d802a2c33f7133fb89ff5d0d031bb320d6b975262d2032. The final merged CLI SHA is 33145250a3bea04b610006b4a24201b5cad2908dc3a35787ab94f009e588b90c; its only change from the measured CLI is the separately gated code16 WASM diagnostics option. Native32 census, decoder, and read-window hashes are identical between measured and final candidate. The measured execution revision and raw report source hashes remain separately recorded.
